profile.headline: Software Engineer at AWS
profile.summary: A proactive and well-trained individual with experience in network communications, embedded computer, cyber security, and gaming development seeks a full-time or part-time job that promotes learning and growth.

positions.title: Software Developer Engineer I
positions.description: As a Linux Engineer at Amazon AWS, I focus on maintaining secure, high-performance Linux systems. My role involves troubleshooting, optimizing, and ensuring system stability, while collaborating with teams to support cloud solutions and automate operations. I work on system updates, patch management, and contribute to improving Amazon’s Linux-based services for enhanced reliability and security.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: I am responsible for developing and maintaining high-performance C and C++ code for embedded devices. My work involves continuous enhancement and modification of our codebase to improve functionality and efficiency.

positions.title: Cyber Security Research Assistant
positions.description:
Develop python scripts to detect vulnerabilities in the kernel of the device using binary analysis libraries.
Improve, modify, and compile android kernel and android operating system.
Develop tools, signatures, and methods of detection for active threats.
Provide strong evidence of specific accomplishments.
Work with other internal and external teams to forge new and improve existing partnerships that help mature the product.
positions.insights: Skills: Assembly Language · Computer Architecture · Python (Programming Language) · Git · High Performance Computing (HPC) · Stored Procedures · C (Programming Language) · Debugging · Binary · Embedded Software · Natural Language Processing (NLP) · Linux · Shell Scripting · Research · Android · Bug Tracking · Software Development · Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) · Analytical Skills · Binary Translation · Linux Kernel · Problem Solving

positions.title: Game Developer
positions.description:
Develop and program games and gaming systems for people with mental disorders following medical directives.
Program many aspects of video games, such as graphics, sound, interface, scripts, etc.
Incorporate voice recognition using cloud services.
Monitor testing and troubleshooting in final stages of software development before going live.
positions.insights: Skills: Unity · Game Development · Computer Science · Git · Stored Procedures · C# · Microsoft Azure · Natural Language Processing (NLP) · Software Development · Game Design · Analytical Skills · Problem Solving

company.name: Apex Systems, Center for Autism & communication Disorders

positions.title: QA Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Supports writing test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on user stories
Generates data prior to testing execution 
Executed test cases manually/automatically to test software performance
Document test results
Communicate defects to the development team
Follow release procedures
Draft and maintain technical product documentation to be used by internal staff for reference
